AirAsia Reports Narrowed Third-Quarter Loss Amid Rising Liabilities

AirAsia's third-quarter financial results showed a narrowed loss, though the airline's cash reserves dwindled and its liabilities increased. The company also issued a warning about anticipated higher fuel costs in the future.
